authors.name: Gurpreet Singh
authors.bio: Gurpreet Singh secured Rank 2 in the Punjab Police Sub-Inspector examination with 713/800 marks and founded House of Aspirants to hand that preparation strategy to every aspirant for free. He writes its monthly current affairs magazine, its weekly live session summaries and the preparation strategy pages. He reviews the exam-oriented material published on this portal against the official syllabus and the official notifications, and mentors aspirants preparing for Punjab Police, PSSSB and PPSC examinations.
authors.award: Rank 2, Punjab Police Sub-Inspector recruitment examination (713/800 marks)

authors.name: House of Aspirants Editorial Team
authors.bio: The House of Aspirants editorial desk writes, fact-checks and reviews everything published on this portal - study notes, current affairs, magazine issues, quiz sets and exam notifications - against the official syllabus, the official notification and the source it cites.
